question: Geçen çeyrekte en yüksek cirolu şehir hangisi?
reference_sql:
SELECT c.City, SUM(oi.Quantity * oi.UnitPrice) AS Ciro
FROM Customers c
JOIN Orders o      ON o.CustomerID = c.CustomerID
JOIN OrderItems oi ON oi.OrderID   = o.OrderID
WHERE o.OrderDate BETWEEN '2026-01-01' AND '2026-03-31'
GROUP BY c.City
ORDER BY Ciro DESC
LIMIT 1;
